name: What types of exterior doors are available for replacement?

mainEntity.name: What types of exterior doors are available for replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common exterior door materials include steel, fiberglass, and wood. Steel doors offer durability and security, often with a good price point. Fiberglass doors provide excellent insulation, resist dents, and can mimic the look of wood. Wood doors offer a classic aesthetic and can be customized, but require more maintenance to protect against weather and pests. Each material has different benefits regarding insulation, security, and maintenance requirements, impacting long-term performance and energy efficiency for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Exterior doors are typically made from steel, fiberglass, or wood, each offering distinct benefits in terms of durability, insulation, and appearance.
